title: CodeChallenge: Grammar tuning in MLP neurons? (part 2)

cues.en: The result of exercise three is a set of activations for each neuron and 100 samples from two categories
cues.zh: 練習三的結果，是每個神經元的活化，包含兩個類別、各 100 個樣本。

cues.en: in exercise four.
cues.zh: 練習四中，

cues.en: You will now perform a statistical analysis on those activations to see whether we can find neurons
cues.zh: 現在要對那些活化做統計分析，看看能否找到神經元，

cues.en: that are statistically significantly more active for nouns versus verbs.
cues.zh: 對名詞的活化在統計上顯著高於動詞，或者相反。

cues.en: So we can do a couple of statistical tests here.
cues.zh: 這裡可以做幾種統計檢定。

cues.en: The one that I will focus on here for simplicity is a paired samples t test, because we have individual neurons that have measurements in two categories.
cues.zh: 為了簡單，這裡著重成對樣本 t 檢定，因為個別神經元在兩個類別都有測量值。

cues.en: So if you've studied statistics before, then you will remember that a paired samples t test is the
cues.zh: 如果學過統計，會記得，成對樣本 t 檢定，

cues.en: same thing as a one sample t test on the difference values with a null hypothesis value of zero.
cues.zh: 等同於對差值做單一樣本 t 檢定，虛無假設值為零。

cues.en: In other words, you can calculate the difference between the activations for the verbs and the nouns,
cues.zh: 換句話說，可以計算動詞與名詞活化的差，

cues.en: and then use the one sample t test function from the Scipy.stats library.
cues.zh: 再使用 scipy.stats 函式庫的單一樣本 t 檢定函式。

cues.en: Now the outputs of this function are t values and p values.
cues.zh: 函式輸出是 t 值與 P 值。

cues.en: And because we are comparing so many neurons, you can use a significance threshold of p equals 0.05 divided by the number of neurons.
cues.zh: 因為比較許多神經元，可以用 P 等於 0.05 除以神經元數，作為顯著性門檻。

cues.en: This corresponds to a Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons.
cues.zh: 這對應多重比較的 Bonferroni 校正。

cues.en: When you finish this test, you can visualize all of the t values in a scatter plot like this, where
cues.zh: 完成檢定後，可以把所有 t 值畫成像這樣的散佈圖，

cues.en: we see the MLP neurons on the x axis and the t value on the y axis.
cues.zh: X 軸是 MLP 神經元，Y 軸是 t 值。

cues.en: Now, I have colored all of these significant results as blue circles and the non-significant t tests using smaller red squares.
cues.zh: 所有顯著結果標成藍色圓圈，不顯著的 t 檢定則用較小紅色方形。

cues.en: Now, because these are difference scores.
cues.zh: 因為這些是差值分數，

cues.en: The positive T values correspond to neurons that have significantly stronger activations for nouns compared
cues.zh: 正 t 值對應神經元，對名詞的活化顯著強於

cues.en: to verbs, and the negative t values correspond to neurons that have stronger activations for verbs compared to nouns.
cues.zh: 動詞；負 t 值則對應，對動詞的活化強於名詞的神經元。

cues.en: So the final step in this exercise is to identify the two neurons that have the most extreme t values, positive and negative.
cues.zh: 所以，最後一步，是找出 t 值最極端的兩個神經元，分別正與負。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So pause the video and good luck working through this one.

cues.en: Finally, we only tested for two parts of speech categories, which doesn't really provide much evidence for selectivity.
cues.zh: 最後，只檢驗兩種詞性類別，無法提供太多選擇性的證據。

cues.en: If you really want to argue that a neuron is selective for a particular category, you would want to
cues.zh: 如果真要主張某神經元對特定類別有選擇性，就會想

cues.en: identify neurons that have more activations for nouns compared to all the other parts of speech, including
cues.zh: 辨識對名詞的活化，高於所有其他詞性的神經元，包含

cues.en: verbs, but also adjectives, adverbs, punctuations, numbers, non-linguistic tokens like HTML tags or Python code, and so on.
cues.zh: 動詞，也包含形容詞、副詞、標點、數字，以及 HTML 標籤或 Python 程式等非語言 token。

cues.en: Nevertheless, my primary goal with this code challenge was to show you how to code for extracting activations and setting up these kinds of analyses.
cues.zh: 不過，這個挑戰的主要目標，是展示如何寫程式擷取活化，設定這類分析。

cues.en: Doing this kind of research rigorously and carefully in practice is going to be like weeks or months
cues.zh: 真正實務上，要嚴謹、細心地做這類研究，可能需要好幾週、好幾個月

cues.en: of full time work to make sure everything is really done correctly and rigorously.
cues.zh: 的全職工作，確保所有事情都正確、嚴謹。
